critical_code_review_comments: validation regex r'\b(test|qa|prueba|asdf|xxxx)\b' is solid but won't catch 'testing', 'qaservice', or non-Latin junk; that's an acceptable trade-off because the lowercase-≤8-chars-≤2-words rule covers most single-word junk like 'palas','xyz','abcd'.

validation triggers BEFORE the 'profile already exists' check (good — we want to reject bad input even on duplicate attempts) and BEFORE role auto-upgrade (also good — we don't want to demote/upgrade a user for invalid input).
